d:
Bihar Weather Update : bihar men mausam ko lekar naya apdet samne aaya hai. mausam vibhag ke purvanuman ke mutabik, rajy men agle panch dinon tak mausam shushk rahne ki sanbhavna hai. patna samet bihar ke adhikansh jilon men mausam samany bana rahega. halanki, kishanganj aur purniya men chhitput barish ke aasar jatae gae hain.
Aise men saval hai ki kya bihar men thand ka asar barhega? kya agle panch dinon tak barish se rahat rahegi? patna samet pure bihar ke mausam ka taja hal janie is riport men.
